claims.text: Dynamic real-time information injection automatically collects current data from credible sources and integrates it into model prompts for LLMs.

evidence.description: The method addresses content hallucination and data relevancy by automatically collecting and integrating current data from credible sources into model prompts.

methodologies.name: Dynamic Real-Time Information Injection
methodologies.description: A framework that dynamically fetches and inserts current information from credible sources into LLM prompts at query time.

limitations.text: Standard LLMs suffer from content hallucination and out-of-date information.
Dynamic real-time information injection results in an increased response time.

future_work.text: Advancements in dynamic data processing in AI.
